fields.title: Check the Localization Chain
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: A client requires storage within the country. List seven places to check and name three that are usually forgotten.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: primary database, backups, analytical storage, logs, CDN and caches, subprocessors, employee access. Forgotten: backups (often in another region for reliability), logs (at a third-party service), employee access from another country. The last one is the most frequent actual violation despite formal compliance.
